limitations: Transitive dependencies and implicit ones (for example kotlin-stdlib added by the Kotlin plugin) are not derived unless a Gradle dependencies report is passed with --resolved.
cacheOnly lists module versions present in the scanned Gradle caches, including build tooling and other projects; presence in a cache does not mean the module ships in the APK.
licence is the POM <license><name> (or its parent POM's); "unverified" means none was readable offline.
notSbom: Inventory of declared and cached Gradle modules; it is not a formal SBOM (no CycloneDX/SPDX, no artifact hashes, no vulnerability data). Licences are copied from POMs and not verified.
